description.p: LinSpectacles is a modular suite of read-only Linux inspection utilities with independently portable applets.
The RPM installs the LinSpectacles Hub application. Applets and Hub Modules may be user-installed or provided as immutable RPM-managed system components.
Separates contextual Hub window titles from the LinSpectacles Hub desktop identity so Dashboard and applet titlebars do not duplicate the application name.
Corrects the contextual Encyclopedia action label and README publication layout while leaving Hub 0.2.0 behavior otherwise unchanged.
Consolidates Hub identity, shortcuts, About and contextual module actions while removing the visible Help and Tools menus.
Restores the original Configuration tab-page frame while leaving tab buttons and runtime behavior unchanged.
Merges Startup configuration into Runtime while preserving startup behavior unchanged.
Corrects Configuration tab framing and adds Cgroups Inspector tree-frame parity without changing runtime behavior.
Refines Configuration tab and Applets table ordering, removes individual tab outlines, and adds sortable Applets and Modules headers.
Simplifies logical Hub Module enablement, clarifies User versus Package-managed ownership, and improves compact sidebar readability.
Consolidates instance-aware Manual/Managed component presentation, Dashboard source provenance and Configuration ownership reporting.
Adds safe Source Portable/Integrated migration and makes runtime mode own the Manual component location while packaged runtimes remain integrated.
Adds a Manual-versus-Managed component preference for duplicate logical IDs while keeping discovery and Configuration instance-complete and never comparing versions.
Corrects integrated-source detection by recognizing the existing desktop integration for this exact source tree, without requiring Suite Pythoine launch arguments or path-name inference.
Attempted source runtime classification through the optional Suite Pythoine launch argument; superseded by 0.1.4.

Introduces explicit Source Portable, Source Integrated and Packaged runtime classification, with Hub configuration/data paths resolved from that model and component-source behavior otherwise preserved.
Refactor-only release decomposing the Hub implementation into focused source units while preserving 0.1.0 runtime and UI behavior.
Establishes one explicit user-selected manual component source plus RPM/system discovery, preserves Manual/RPM duplicate copies visibly, and adds compact version/source applet navigation provenance.
Aligns Hub table alternating rows with Kernel Modules and tab corner geometry with Linux ResMon, without changing runtime behavior.
Fixes Dashboard type-to-search so module-owned text fields such as Encyclopedia search retain keyboard input instead of redirecting it to applet search.
Corrects Applet Organizer integration to use Favourite/Category columns in the single Applets table and extends Portable discovery to shared User/XDG and System (RPM) fallback stores.
Makes applet search a permanent Hub capability and adds Module API 6 Applets-page extensions so optional organization features enhance the existing Applets and Hub State surfaces.
Completes the official offline Hub Module catalogue with Boot Environment and System Identity.
Adds dual-source applet and Hub Module discovery for RPM installs, with user overrides taking precedence over system-installed components and package-manager ownership respected.
Clarifies LinSpectacles Hub identity in About surfaces and removes temporary RPM package-name obsoletion ahead of the finalized package taxonomy.
Adopts the LinSpectacles Hub package and repository identity while preserving the visible LinSpectacles application identity, command and user-owned component model.
Renames the Fedora/COPR package to linspectacles-suite and adds upgrade compatibility from the former linspectacles package; application runtime behavior is unchanged.
Improves RPM and AppStream identity metadata for package and software-center presentation; application runtime behavior is unchanged.
